# PROCESS — cand_0010 (parent cand_0005, champion, val 0.604)

## Decision: HONEST HAND-BACK — no prose edit shipped this iteration
After a full fresh diagnosis of all 36 failing traces (4 parallel read-only subagents + my own
direct reads of the pivotal traces and of the fragile passers), the conclusion is decisive and
evidence-backed: **every prose lever that could touch the remaining failing tasks has already been
tried and REGRESSED**, and the residual failures are interpretation-variance (underdetermined or
internally-contradictory gold) or infrastructure faults — neither prose-fixable. Shipping a 5th
speculative batch that re-treads a refuted lever is expected-negative (it would trade a fragile
passer for a fix, as cand_0006–0009 each did), so the disciplined action is to preserve the
champion and hand back the diagnosis. This is explicitly a valid iteration outcome per the task
rules ("no wording could make the task achievable → say so in PROCESS.md rather than shipping a
hopeful paragraph"). prompt.md and task_template.md are UNCHANGED.

## Why every surfaced fix is unsafe (maps to an already-refuted lever)
Root cause of the plateau: the 36 failing tasks share their decision-space (formula-handling,
verification, example-sheet conventions, sentinel/type coercion) with the fragile passers
{45581 (INDEX fill), 31420 (VLOOKUP range), 56561 (ArrayFormula), 50682, 430-43, 399-14}. Any rule
strong enough to flip a failing task flips one of these — which is exactly why cand_0006 (−0.044),
cand_0007 (−0.022), cand_0008 (−0.033) and cand_0009 (Δ0, broke 31420+56561) each netted ≤0.

| Sub-cluster (failing tasks) | Fix the sweep proposed | Prior iteration that shipped it | Gate result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Array/modern-formula recalc → write literal value (53023, 55258, 58890, 6698) | "write value not formula" / extend the array caveat to name COUNTIFS-array-constant, `MATCH(1,(A=x)*(B=y),0)`, NUMBERVALUE | cand_0001, cand_0006, cand_0007 | REFUTED (cand_0006 broke {35747,41410,42930,50250,56561}, −0.044) |
| `data_only=True` aggregation over formula cells (47699) | read cached values with data_only when counting | cand_0007, cand_0009 | REFUTED (cand_0009 broke {31420,56561}) |
| Validate/align to in-sheet expected/example/illustration cells (45944, 58484, 347-49, 398-14, 413-15) | "conform to the demo/expected-outcome sheet's conventions (0 vs '-', blank cells, ordering)" | cand_0008 (conventions); cand_0002 (adversarial verify rewrite) | REFUTED (cand_0008 broke {45581,50682,56561}; cand_0002 broke 267-18) |

The subagents' "FORMULA-RECALC → formulas come back blank" theory (raised for 50755/10281/32468) is
the documented RED HERRING: the scorer recalculates standard formulas via LibreOffice (proven by the
formula-writing passers 45581/31420/56561 scoring 3/3). Verified directly on 50755: its answer cells
already hold *heterogeneous, buggy* demo formulas (`=D2-D4`, `=F1-F3`) that don't match the
instruction's uniform "2nd−3rd" rule — so keeping them scores 0. That is interpretation-variance, not
recalc.

## Interpretation-variance / inconsistent gold — NOT safely fixable by any general rule
250-20 (tc2 gold sums a 4-row group to 1 and contains phantom rows absent from its own input),
269-44 (gold uses an inconsistent exact-vs-substring 'Chassis' match + buggy descending-shift order),
146-49 (arbitrary column-assignment + alphabetical row order), 577-40 (`'-'` treated as blank —
DIRECTLY CONTRADICTS 398-14 where `'-'`→0, so no single rule can serve both), plus 4225, 50486,
585-41, 14207, 30930, 32975, 32023, 39946, 48983, 49782, 50526, 53305, 53449, 55039, 157-4, 50755.
The single visible file underdetermines the gold reading; several golds are mutually contradictory.
Any disambiguating rule would be a task-specific literal (overfits, fails the held-out gate) or would
flip a currently-passing task.

## INFRA — out of prose scope, handed back for a human / code capability
- **34-5**: "delete rows before current month" — frozen expected file authored on an unknown past
  date; no worked example pins "today". Reference date unknowable from the file.
- **55912**: input XLSX is invalid XML; openpyxl cannot open it and no LibreOffice fallback ran →
  garbage output. Environment/tooling fault.
- **53062**: answer depends on a recalc chain through `=MID(...)`/nested `=IF(...COUNTIFS...)` cells
  (one with malformed `OR(,…)`) over a large range; the chain does not resolve.
- **269-44**: also exhibits literal-correct-but-scored-0 behavior (see above).

## The one marginal edge (deliberately NOT shipped)
267-18: gold prepends `//` at the very START of the CONCATENATE (`=CONCATENATE("//","[",…)`), the
agent inserted it after `[`. A "prefix means prepend at the very beginning" definitional clarification
is the only lever outside the refuted minefield — but it is a single-task fix that cannot clear the
significance bar alone, and I cannot enumerate that no "add a prefix/suffix" passer inserts mid-string,
so it carries unbounded-ish risk for zero class-level upside. Dropped as failing the SAFE + (bar) tests.

## Deliberately NOT re-tried (prior RESULTS refuted these — never re-test)
- write-literals / extend array-formula caveat (cand_0001, cand_0006 −0.044).
- `data_only` aggregation (cand_0007 −0.022, cand_0009 Δ0-with-regression).
- demonstration/expected-sheet output conventions (cand_0008 −0.033).
- independent/adversarial VERIFY rewrite of step 3 (cand_0002, broke 267-18).
- global no-embellishment block (cand_0002); cand_0004 whole batch; blue-column fill (cand_0002);
  literal implied-match narrowing (cand_0009 Δ0, broke 31420+56561).

## Process & features used
4 parallel read-only Explore subagents partitioned the 36 failing traces; I personally verified the
two pivotal claims (50755 formula-recalc red herring; fragile-passer decision-space overlap for
45581/31420/56561) by reading those traces directly. No worktrees needed (zero edits). Both editable
files (prompt.md, task_template.md) intentionally left byte-identical to the champion.

## Recommendation to the run
Prose is mined out. Remaining gains require NON-PROSE levers, out of this capability's scope:
(1) a deterministic post-processor (recalc-safe-formula rewrite for array/modern constructs; or
force cached-value materialization) — but scoped so it does not touch the formula-writing passers;
(2) the infra fixes (34-5 frozen-date anchor; 55912 XML repair + LibreOffice availability; 53062
recalc chain). Do NOT ship a 5th prose batch against the refuted levers.
